verdicts.reason: Does not accept or promise the 15 %; says it must be evaluated by the commercial director.
Offers 5 % applicable only if the full year is paid in advance.
Will forward to Lucía, the commercial director, with no definitive rejection; no response date promised, only that it may not be this week.
Has subject, uses usted, body about 110 words, signed Carmen Ejemplo.
No margin, no 48 000 MXN figure, no other percentages, no Monday or new dates.
